mapper.sql: t.id, t.batch_id, t.student_id, t.status, t.answer_count, t.total_items, t.score_total, t.score_band, t.result_level, t.result_note, t.result_by, t.interviewed, t.interview_note, t.interviewed_by, t.interviewed_at, t.started_at, t.submitted_at, t.duration_seconds, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(u.student_id, '') AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, '') AS class_name, COALESCE(sp.major, '') AS major, COALESCE(sp.grade, '') AS grade, COALESCE(b.batch_name, '') AS batch_name
FROM psyche_task t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.student_id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = t.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN psyche_batch b ON b.id = t.batch_id

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.student_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psyche_task (batch_id, student_id, status, answer_count, total_items, score_total, score_band, result_level, result_note, result_by, interviewed, interview_note, interviewed_by, interviewed_at, started_at, submitted_at, duration_seconds, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{studentId}, #{status}, #{answerCount}, #{totalItems}, #{scoreTotal}, #{scoreBand}, #{resultLevel}, #{resultNote}, #{resultBy}, #{interviewed}, #{interviewNote}, #{interviewedBy}, #{interviewedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{submittedAt}, #{durationSeconds}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE t.batch_id = #{batchId} AND t.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT
WHERE t.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE psyche_task SET status = 'in_progress', started_at = #{startedAt}, total_items = #{totalItems}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE psyche_task SET status = 'completed', answer_count = #{answerCount}, total_items = #{totalItems}, score_total = #{scoreTotal}, score_band = #{scoreBand}, duration_seconds = #{durationSeconds}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE psyche_task SET result_level = #{resultLevel}, result_note = #{resultNote}, result_by = #{resultBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE psyche_task SET interviewed = #{interviewed}, interview_note = #{interviewNote}, interviewed_by = #{interviewedBy}, interviewed_at = #{interviewedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE psyche_task SET status = 'absent', updated_at = NOW() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('pending', 'in_progress')
mapper.select: SELECT t.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM psyche_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.batch_id = #{batchId} GROUP BY t.status

SELECT COALESCE(sp.class_name, '') AS class_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done FROM psyche_task t LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = t.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.batch_id = #{batchId} GROUP BY COALESCE(sp.class_name, '') ORDER BY class_name

SELECT COALESCE(sp.major, '') AS major, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done FROM psyche_task t LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = t.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.batch_id = #{batchId} GROUP BY COALESCE(sp.major, '') ORDER BY major
